meta_title: All VpnHood! Features: Cloak Mode, Split Tunneling, DNS
meta_description: Every feature in VpnHood!: Cloak Mode, protocols, Smart Proxies, split tunneling, private DNS, kill switch, always on and quick launch.
title: Every VpnHood! feature, explained
lead: What each control does, when you would want it, and which platforms have it.
shot_alt: The VpnHood! app connected on a phone
cloak_mode_short: Disguises VPN traffic as ordinary web traffic, so a filter has nothing familiar to match.
protocols_short: Switch between UDP, TCP and QUIC to suit the network you are on.
proxies_short: Paste a proxy list and the app tests it, rates every proxy, rotates the best ones and keeps the list fresh.
split_tunneling_short: Choose what goes through the VPN: by country, domain, app, IP address or local network.
private_dns_short: Keeps Android Private DNS working inside the tunnel, and lets you pick the DNS servers the tunnel uses.
kill_switch_short: Blocks the internet connection if the VPN drops, so nothing leaks in the gap.
always_on_short: Keeps the device connected to the VPN, even after restarts and network changes.
quick_launch_short: Connect from the Android quick settings panel with a single tap.
